description: Akasha hooks. They act only in repositories that have akasha.toml.

hooks.command: "$(command -v python || command -v python3)" -X utf8 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/akasha_run.py" hook --event SessionStart
"$(command -v python || command -v python3)" -X utf8 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/akasha_run.py" hook --event PreToolUse
"$(command -v python || command -v python3)" -X utf8 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/akasha_run.py" hook --event PostToolUse
"$(command -v python || command -v python3)" -X utf8 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/akasha_run.py" hook --event Stop
